notes: Two routes from Musaddad (ح) meet at «عن خالد»: the tail is Khalid, Abu Qilaba, Malik b. al-Huwayrith
«- المعنى واحد -» is an editor's gloss, left out; «قال خالد قلت لأبي قلابة» in Isma'il's version is a question inside the chain, a remark, left out
«إسماعيل» occurrence 1 is the chain's; the second occurrence is in «حديث إسماعيل» (a remark)
